entries.t: <FACE:95>Ah! There he is!<NL>That's the guy!
<FACE:95>Hey, you there!<NL><WAIT>You're gonna pay for<NL>what happened before!
<FACE:91>What is it, Kikuhime!<NL><WAIT>Did you drag us in as<NL>Robattle help again!
<FACE:92>Well, I figured it'd<NL>be like this anyway…<WAIT><FACE:91>Quit using people like<NL>this…
<FACE:00>Are you the famous<NL>Medafighter Ikki?<WAIT><FACE:91>Huh! Famous!?<NL>
<FACE:91>Aw, no… come on…<NL>Famous, me…?<WAIT><FACE:00>I wanted to ask you<NL>something… You're…
<FACE:95>Hey! Enough chatting!<NL>Off to the Robattle!<WAIT><FACE:91>Uh… but this guy<NL>wants to talk to me…
<FACE:95>What a pain!<NL>I put Ikki on my team<WAIT>figuring the Robattles<NL>here would work out…<WAIT>So much for that plan!<NL>
<FACE:95>…But you, on the other<NL>hand…<WAIT>You've got real skill!<NL><WAIT>I could team up with<NL>you now and then
<FACE:03>Huh! No, never mind<NL>that… It's Ikki I…
<FACE:95>No way, not that guy!<NL>He's totally useless!
<FACE:95>Forget him and call<NL>us anytime, okay!<WAIT>See ya!
<FACE:96>Ah! Wait a sec…<NL>Boss laaady!?
<FACE:03>Ah!
<FACE:00>Anyway, Ikki!<NL>You and this Shiden…<WAIT><FACE:91>…No way… losing that<NL>easily…
<FACE:03>It wasn't that easy!<NL>It was a close one…
<FACE:91>Spare me the pity!
<FACE:92>Ah! Wait, Ikkiii!?
<FACE:04>I only came to deliver<NL>a package…<WAIT>…against little kids…<NL>Me… what am I doing…
<FACE:95>Kikuhime joined the<NL>team!<NL><WAIT><FACE:96>Iwanoi joined the<NL>team!<NL><WAIT><FACE:97>Kagamiyama joined the<NL>team!
